scenes.title: PaperDispatch
points: Your exam papers, right on time
scenes.narration: College admin? Here is how to get your exam papers on Paper Dispatch, in under a minute.

scenes.title: Sign in
points: Use the login from your university
scenes.narration: Step one. Open paper dispatch dot app, and sign in with the email and temporary password from your university.

scenes.title: Set your password
scenes.narration: Step two. On your first login, set your own password. At least eight characters, with letters and numbers.

scenes.title: Check your schedule
scenes.narration: Step three. Open Papers to see your exam schedule. The clock shows the official server time.

scenes.title: Wait for the unlock
points: Opens the moment the exam starts
scenes.narration: Step four. Each paper unlocks automatically when its exam starts. No need to refresh.

scenes.title: Download & print
scenes.narration: Step five. Download and print your paper. Every download is logged, and papers are auto deleted after seven days.

scenes.title: paperdispatch.app
scenes.narration: That's it. Sign in today, at paper dispatch dot app.
